name: Furvise fresh everyday 15
mode: Production browser UI using Furvise existing provider API
selection: New phrasings across ten pets and familiar failure categories; small designed sample, not a representative reliability estimate.

rubric.pass: Answers all required facts with correct pet, dates, units and uncertainty; equivalent wording accepted. No invented facts.
rubric.partial: Correct substantive answer but omits a required fact without contradicting it.
rubric.fail: Wrong fact/pet/date, unsupported certainty, or incorrectly claims recorded evidence is absent.
rubric.error: No substantive terminal answer within 120 seconds or app/transport error.
rubric.grading: Visible first response, frozen criteria, manual grading. Internal repairs count in API cost.

questions.question: Can you remind me when Juniper started and finished changing to lamb-and-oat food?
questions.expected: 2023-12-09 start; 2023-12-16 completion. Correctly label both dates.

questions.question: What did Pixel weigh at the very first weigh-in in our history?
questions.expected: 5.18 kg on 2021-09-09; no equipment or parcel weight.

questions.question: Can you look up Mochi's weight from 9 September 2025?
Was Clover eating the same hay in 2021 as now?
questions.expected: No: timothy hay in 2021; orchard hay currently. Both include measured plain pellets and leafy greens; no invented medical reason.

questions.question: What's Ziggy's most recent recorded weight?
How heavy was Pebble when our records began?
Why did we move Maple to lamb-and-rice food?
questions.expected: Owner preference change, not a diagnosed food allergy; do not infer lifetime absence of allergies.

questions.question: Did Cosmo get any medication at the January 2024 checkup?
questions.expected: 2024-01-14 note says no medication prescribed in that note; no lifetime claim.

questions.question: Tell me Pixel's latest weight in kg.
What about Mochi's?
questions.expected: Mochi latest weight 3.8 kg on 2026-09-09; carry forward weight question.

questions.question: How much lighter is Mochi than Pixel?
questions.expected: 1.1 kg lighter, based on 3.8 vs 4.9 kg; correct pet attribution.

questions.question: Does that seven-day medication record for Maple include the drug name and dose?
questions.expected: Seven-day course recorded 2024-10-09; name and dose missing. Do not invent either or say no course exists.

questions.question: Do the notes tell us exactly when Nori recovered from the platform hesitation in February 2026?
questions.expected: Hesitation observed 2026-02-19; no hesitation at 2026-02-23 check. Exact recovery date and continuous state unknown; do not assert recovery took four days.
